products.name: Videoleap
products.note: Mobile video editing AI; effects; templates; Israeli vendor

profile_text.body:
Lightricks is an Israeli AI technology company that develops creative tools for content creators, marketers, and professionals across web, mobile, and open source platforms. The company describes itself as focused on transforming creative workflows through AI-powered products, and frames its strategic direction around what it calls the Open Creativity Stack, an ecosystem of AI tools and models intended to give creators, studios, and enterprises greater flexibility and speed than it says closed systems currently allow.

One of its tracked products is Videoleap, a mobile video editing application that incorporates AI-driven effects and templates. Beyond mobile, the company states it is active in web and open source development as part of its broader push toward interconnected creative infrastructure.
